settings.heading: 1. How do I find my grill’s model number?
settings.text: Check common locations such as side or back of the grill. Alternatively, refer to your owner’s manual for the model number.

settings.heading: 2. How do I purchase replacement parts?
settings.text: Click on “View Parts,” find the corresponding part at the images, then add it to your cart for checkout

settings.heading: 3. How do I replace a part?
settings.text: Refer to your owner’s manual for detailed instructions on replacing parts. If you require further assistance, please contact our Customer Service.

settings.heading: 4. What if the part I need is out of stock?
settings.text: We will restock the item as quickly as possible. Please be patient.

settings.heading: 5. How do I know if a part is compatible with my grill?
settings.text: To ensure compatibility, enter your grill’s model number when searching for parts. Each part is designed specifically for certain grill models, so this will help you find the right match.

settings.heading: 6. How can I track my order?
settings.text: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can use this number to track the status of your delivery.

settings.heading: 7. Can I return or exchange a replacement part?
settings.text: Yes, returns and exchanges are accepted on unused parts within 30 days of purchase. For returns, please contact our Customer Service for assistance.

settings.heading: 8. Do you offer any warranties on replacement parts?
settings.text: Yes, you can refer to WARRANTY PAGE for detail. if your grill is in warranty period, you can submit warranty application.

settings.heading: 9. How long does it take for replacement parts to arrive?
settings.text: Shipping times vary depending on your location. Typically, parts will arrive within 3-7 business days.

settings.heading: 10. What should I do if I receive a damaged or incorrect part?
settings.text: If you receive a damaged or incorrect part, please contact Customer Service immediately. We’ll assist you with returns, exchanges, or replacements as needed.
